name: Angels and the sons of God
about: Who the sons of God are (believers by faith, never angels), and what the Bible says of angels and Satan.

teachings.title: The sons of God came before the Lord, and Satan among them
teachings.theme: The sons of God are believers
teachings.summary: The sons of God before the throne in Job 1 are the saved, the same children of obedience as in Genesis 6, and Satan came among them as a separate being, an angel who still accuses the brethren today.
teachings.text:
And so we find Job, faithfully keeping the sanctification of sacrifices for himself and his children, and he has been blessed beyond measure by God.

10 children, seven sons and three daughters. Incredible wealth and cattle and livestock. Great land and a great house. And all his adult children successful in that they were established in their own homes to have their own feasts. Having established all of this, the Bible shifts focus to the throne of God in Heaven.

*Now there was a day when the sons of God came to present themselves before the Lord, and Satan came also among them.*

I've covered this multiple times in other studies, but the sons of God here refers to the spirits of those saved by faith in Christ. The same as the sons of God in **Genesis 6** being the children of obedience, through Seth. Because the only way to become A son of God, is by faith in THE Son of God.

So, not to belabor the point, but at no time has God called angels His sons. And further evidence of this is in the text itself, in verse 6. Satan came also among them.

Satan is an angel. A rebellious angel, a cherub. Perhaps a prominent angel but, an angel nonetheless. And he came among them, as a separate entity than them. Not as one of them.

And God asks him where he's been, and he says going to and fro in the earth and walking up and down in it.

**1 Peter 5:8**
*Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour*

Christians should remember that Satan continues this practice today.

And like his appearance before God, to accuse Job, he does the same of us even now.

**Revelation 12:9-11**
*And the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world: he was cast out into the earth, and his angels were cast out with him. And I heard a loud voice saying in heaven, Now is come salvation, and strength, and the kingdom of our God, and the power of his Christ: for the accuser of our brethren is cast down, which accused them before our God day and night. And they overcame him by the blood of the Lamb, and by the word of their testimony; and they loved not their lives unto the death*.

Satan is our adversary, the god of this world, and our accuser before the Lord.

I sometimes wonder if he even bothers with the unsaved, beyond giving them power that they can afflict those who are saved. His resentment is in those sons of God, that God so loved us that He gave His only begotten Son for us, knowing that hell was created for him and the angels he deceived.

teachings.title: Nephilim and serpent seed are not biblical
teachings.summary: Says Nephilim, serpent seed and similar teachings about angels and demons are not biblical and quotes Colossians 2:18.
teachings.text:
Reminder that "Nephilim," "serpent seed" and other false doctrines about angels and demons that men use to make merchandise of simple people are not Biblical, and hurt the cause of Christ. 

***Let no man beguile you of your reward in a voluntary humility and worshipping of angels, intruding into those things which he hath not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind***

Ultimately, demon-human sex-stories are pornography for goofy people.

teachings.title: Equal unto the angels
teachings.summary: Explains Luke 20:36 in its context of the Sadducees and the resurrection, noting that Jesus is describing what believers will be: undying children of God.
teachings.text:
**Luke 20:36**
*Neither can they die any more: for they are equal unto the angels; and are the children of God, being the children of the resurrection.*

We know the context, that Jesus is talking to the Sadducees, and answering their foolish hypothetical about a woman married to 7 brothers under the law of Moses. They tried to paint a contradiction into the idea of the resurrection of believers, and Jesus responded by saying this. That we aren't taken in marriage in the glorified eternal life awaiting us. 

I want to point out that one, the resurrection on the day of redemption was understood as a concept, and something many Jews believed on, and trusted. Salvation was always by faith in the free gift of eternal life. Calling upon the name of the Lord to save you. 

But, more importantly, go back up and read the verse again. Jesus is describing us. What we will be like. Undying children of God. 

Amen.

teachings.title: Satan was created, and the gap theory is false
teachings.summary: Quotes Ezekiel 28 and teaches that Satan is a created being, not a balance to God, and that the gap theory is a false doctrine since God called His finished creation very good. Traces Satan's fall, Hell prepared for the devil and his angels, and the plan of salvation in the Lamb slain before the foundation of the world.
teachings.text:
**Ezekiel 28**

*12 Son of man, take up a lamentation upon the king of Tyrus, and say unto him, Thus saith the Lord God; Thou sealest up the sum, full of wisdom, and perfect in beauty.

13 Thou hast been in Eden the garden of God; every precious stone was thy covering, the sardius, topaz, and the diamond, the beryl, the onyx, and the jasper, the sapphire, the emerald, and the carbuncle, and gold: the workmanship of thy tabrets and of thy pipes was prepared in thee in the day that thou wast created.

14 Thou art the anointed cherub that covereth; and I have set thee so: thou wast upon the holy mountain of God; thou hast walked up and down in the midst of the stones of fire.

15 Thou wast perfect in thy ways from the day that thou wast created, till iniquity was found in thee.

16 By the multitude of thy merchandise they have filled the midst of thee with violence, and thou hast sinned: therefore I will cast thee as profane out of the mountain of God: and I will destroy thee, O covering cherub, from the midst of the stones of fire.

17 Thine heart was lifted up because of thy beauty, thou hast corrupted thy wisdom by reason of thy brightness: I will cast thee to the ground, I will lay thee before kings, that they may behold thee.

18 Thou hast defiled thy sanctuaries by the multitude of thine iniquities, by the iniquity of thy traffick; therefore will I bring forth a fire from the midst of thee, it shall devour thee, and I will bring thee to ashes upon the earth in the sight of all them that behold thee.

19 All they that know thee among the people shall be astonished at thee: thou shalt be a terror, and never shalt thou be any more.*

**Ephesians 6:12**
*For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places.*

**Isaiah 14**
*
12 How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning! how art thou cut down to the ground, which didst weaken the nations!

13 For thou hast said in thine heart, I will ascend into heaven, I will exalt my throne above the stars of God: I will sit also upon the mount of the congregation, in the sides of the north:

14 I will ascend above the heights of the clouds; I will be like the most High.*

Keeping in mind who Lucifer is, Satan. That old serpent. 

Knowing that the rulers of this world are given over to him. But it is important to note the Bible teaches that Satan is a created being. Satan was created by God. There was a day where Satan was created. The Heaven and the Earth was created in the 1st day so Satan was created in that first day. 

Some believe the devil is some sort of balance to God, or the Mormons say Jesus 'brother. These are blasphemous statements. Satan is a creature, Jesus the Creator. 

There is a false doctrine called the "Gap theory" that claims, among other things that Satan fell during creation week. That some time, millions of years in fact, passed between Genesis 1:1 and 1:2. And that in those millions of years a world was created, and fell, because of Satan and the 3rd of hosts that fell with him. 

It's a silly doctrine. We know that when God looks at His creation after His work was done, that He found it was "very good." Perfect. Complete. 

Not *very good* *other than the botched world and fallen angels. *

But Satan fell before Eve took of the apple. Iniquity was found in him, and many believe it was the love of man by God that did it. 

When Satan fell, and brought his murderous lie to Eve, casting doubt on God's word, he was attempting to place God in a difficult position with His beloved creation of man. 

We see in **Matthew 25:41** that Hell was created for Satan and the others who rebel with him. 

*Then shall he say also unto them on the left hand, Depart from me, ye cursed, into everlasting fire, prepared for the devil and his angels.*

And knowing his ultimate fate at the judgment of the Lord, earned by his own inequities, he sought to bring down man with him. 

But God, having seen beginning to the end, knowing all things, being the exalted creator, already had a plan of salvation for fallen man. The lamb slain before the foundation of the world. Jesus Christ. And those who called upon the name of the Lord, gave He the power to became Sons of God, given eternal life. Heirs to an eternal kingdom. 

And His beloved mankind turned to a nation like unto the sand, or the stars. Filling up Heaven. Death defeated. Hell and Satan and all unbelieving, cast into the lake of fire, where the smoke of their torment rises forever. 

And Satan's ultimate defeat is known to him. And so, he goes before God, among the sons of God to accuse us, night and day. Like a ravenous lion seeking whom he may devour. Biting at the heel of Christ, who in turn crushes his head.

teachings.title: The angel of the LORD and Sennacherib
teachings.summary: Reads 2 Kings 19:35-36 on God's deliverance, noting that He sometimes responds to prayer out of His own pleasure and plans.
teachings.text:
**2 Kings 19:35–36**
*And it came to pass that night, that the angel of the LORD went out, and smote in the camp of the Assyrians an hundred fourscore and five thousand: and when they arose early in the morning, behold, they were all dead corpses. So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed, and went and returned, and dwelt at Nineveh.*

When Jerusalem was surrounded and under siege, is likely when **Psalm 44** was written and sung. 

**2 Kings 19:32–34**
*Therefore thus saith the LORD concerning the king of Assyria, He shall not come into this city, nor shoot an arrow there, nor come before it with shield, nor cast a bank against it. By the way that he came, by the same shall he return, and shall not come into this city, saith the LORD. **For I will defend this city, to save it, for mine own sake, and for my servant David’s sake.***

It is always interesting to see that it was the preservation of Jerusalem itself and the promise made to David that motivated God to act. 

King Hezekiah and the prophet Isaiah tore their clothes, humbled themselves, and cried out to God in intense prayer for deliverance. The sons of Korah wrote and sang Psalms. The people lamented and prayed. 

But, what seems to have motivated Him wasn't necessarily His people. God considered His pleasure, promises and plans, and relented, confounding and destroying the army before the gates. 

It pleased Him to defend the city, to save it, for His own sake, and the promise He had made. 

Many times, our effectual and fervent prayers are answered, and God delivers us out of mercy and grace. But sometimes, it is His pleasure, promises and plans that He responds to. 

It is something to keep in mind as we look to do His will and take joy in it being done.

teachings.title: Demon possession and Catholic exorcisms
teachings.summary: Gives the Baptist view that demon possession affects the unsaved, doubts Catholic exorcisms, and cautions against dismissing all possession as mental illness.
teachings.text:
I think that 99.9% of Catholic "exorcisms" are fraudulent. Like entirely performative and made up. The same way so many of their "apparitions" and "mold on the window looks like Mary!" Or "this inanimate object bleeding! (It's an old magic trick)" are.

In Baptist circles, generally shared doctrine on demonic possession is that it only affects unsaved people (the Spirit within the saved prevents this) and that it often is the result of sin/occult practices inviting them in. This leads to those cases brought forward to either be prayed over, fasting, etc, or outright saying it isn't their problem. But deliverance ministries are pretty often called in and successful (there are many fraudulent, false gospel people calling themselves Deliverance Ministries, but legitimate practitioners exist, and many pastors either know a guy or know of a guy). 

It usually is a quiet affair, and not turned into a show of Latin and special FX nonsense. And the goal is to get the person cleaned AND saved. 

The problem with any false gospel form of exorcism is obviously this:

**Matthew 12:43-45**
*When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, he walketh through dry places, seeking rest, and findeth none. Then he saith, I will return into my house from whence I came out; and when he is come, he findeth it empty, swept, and garnished. Then goeth he, and taketh with himself seven other spirits more wicked than himself, and they enter in and dwell there: and the last state of that man is worse than the first. Even so shall it be also unto this wicked generation*.

And finally, because saved Christians tend not to be anywhere near as superstitious as Catholics, there's a modern tendency to dismiss what is demonic possession as just mental illness or addiction or whatever. And so they don't even address it. 

Meanwhile, Catholics will turn to a supernatural explanation, even when it is just like drug induced psychosis. Basically two ends of a spectrum if you see what I mean.

teachings.title: Who are the sons of God?
teachings.summary: Scripture defines the sons of God as believers who receive Christ and are adopted as joint heirs with Him, from Seth's day to now.
teachings.text:
And so, who are the sons of God? The Bible says *as many as received him, to them gave he power to become the sons of God, even to them that believe on his name.*

Believers. Those that call upon the name of the Lord.

*For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, they are the sons of God. And if children, then heirs; heirs of God, and joint-heirs with Christ; if so be that we suffer with him, that we may be also glorified together. For I reckon that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which shall be revealed in us. For the earnest expectation of the creature waiteth for the manifestation of the sons of God. For the creature was made subject to vanity, not willingly, but by reason of him who hath subjected the same in hope, Because the creature itself also shall be delivered from the bondage of corruption into the glorious liberty of the children of God.*

Those born again into the promise, adopted sons, heirs to the Kingdom of the Lord.

Adopted now, as in the days of Seth and Enos and Enoch and even Noah; *That ye may be blameless and harmless, the sons of God, without rebuke, in the midst of a crooked and perverse nation, among whom ye shine as lights in the world.*

*Behold, what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us, that we should be called the sons of God!*

Take comfort in this knowledge, joy in the incomprehensible love God has shown us, that we may be adopted joint heirs with His only begotten Son, Christ Jesus.

*Beloved, now are we the sons of God, and it doth not yet appear what we shall be: but we know that, when he shall appear, we shall be like him; for we shall see him as he is.*

We know that all who believe are the sons of God. That we appear before God in Heaven to present ourselves before the Lord. When God laid Jesus as the cornerstone of our salvation, the angels sang and all the sons of God shouted for joy. And in Christ Jesus God has made His covenant with man, that He *will be a Father unto you, and ye shall be my sons and daughters, saith the Lord Almighty.*

teachings.title: Angels are not sons of God
teachings.summary: Scripture says God never called angels His sons and they do not marry, which refutes the doctrine of angel-human hybrids in Genesis 6.
teachings.text:
But what of angels, the creations of God who serve divine purpose? The hosts of heaven? Are they sons of God?

The Bible definitively says no**;**

*For unto which of the angels said he at any time, Thou art my Son, this day have I begotten thee? And again, I will be to him a Father, and he shall be to me a Son?*

*And of the angels he saith, Who maketh his angels spirits, and his ministers a flame of fire.*

...*For unto the angels hath he not put in subjection the world to come, whereof we speak.But one in a certain place testified, saying, What is man, that thou art mindful of him? or the son of man that thou visitest him? Thou madest him a little lower than the angels; thou crownedst him with glory and honour, and didst set him over the works of thy hands.*

And so we see that angels, while higher created beings than man, are in no way the sons of God, for they are below man in our dominion as sons of God. They aren't heirs to the promise. They are not partakers with Christ, they but serve God and His heirs, or rebel and tempt and accuse.

*Are they not all ministering spirits, sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation?*

And all angels are spirit, not flesh, and not made in the image and likeness of God. Jesus, describing their limitations as He spoke of our glorified bodies in the resurrection; *For in the resurrection they neither marry, nor are given in marriage, but are as the angels of God in heaven*.

*The children of this world marry, and are given in marriage: But they which shall be accounted worthy to obtain that world, and the resurrection from the dead, neither marry, nor are given in marriage: Neither can they die any more: for they are equal unto the angels; and are the children of God, being the children of the resurrection.*

And so, mindful of what the Bible says (and does not say), we can draw doctrine that counters the claim of half-human hybrids made of spiritual things copulating with daughters of men. Angels are servants of God, ministers to us that are saved in Christ. That we are His children, His sons. What love He has for us! Amen.
